# Dialog: Explainer Modal with Persist Preference

Implement the modal explainer dialog that fires on premium-incurring same-turn buy-and-play.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **Dialog content explains the rule** — The dialog states that buy-and-place costs 50% more when no actions are available, explaining the action economy rationale. Copy: "Placing a business card from hand in the same turn costs 50% more because you have no actions left."
- [ ] **Options: Proceed / Cancel** — "Proceed" dismisses the dialog and allows the placement to continue (premium price charged). "Cancel" dismisses the dialog and aborts the placement (card returns to hand, no coins deducted).
- [ ] **"Don't show this again" checkbox** — A checkbox below the options. When checked and confirmed/cancelled, the dismissal preference is persisted (SettingsStore-style or localStorage).
- [ ] **Preference is checked before dialog** — On subsequent premium-incurring buy-and-play, the stored preference is checked; if dismissed, the dialog does not fire and placement proceeds at premium price.
- [ ] **Overlay depth conventions followed** — Backdrop at depth 199, box at depth 200, text/buttons at depth 201. All elements parented into s.hudContainer. Uses createOverlayBackground / createOverlayButton / dismissOverlay pattern (same as showSellConfirmation).
- [ ] **Reduced-motion / mute respected** — Dialog animations respect reduced-motion preference. No SFX on the dialog itself.

## Key Files

- example-games/main-street/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts — new showBuyAndPlacePremiumDialog function
- src/ui/SettingsStore.ts or a Main Street prefs module — preference key: main-street.buyAndPlacePremiumDialogDismissed

## Dependencies

- Depends on the turn controller triggering the dialog (child CG-0MT76N0XX000XXXX).
